8165.title: Grouped settings rows impose a one-line title limit
8165.rootCauseOneLine: GroupedRow defaults titleLines to 1 and forwards that cap without consulting font scale.

prReviews.verdict: Static-only: plausible root-cause direction; native validation pending

8165.proposedFix: Allow enlarged iOS grouped-row titles to wrap; validate native layout and intentional title limits in the existing PR.
8165.caveats: Component contract reproduced twice on unchanged trusted main. Native iOS truncation and screenshots unavailable on Linux; open PR #8167 already links the issue. Broad baseline builds fail on missing Plugin SDK runtime output.
